unknowns.what: the rule that combines the parameters (what multiplies what, in which order)
unknowns.why: every `FunctionExpressions` slot of the 11 Batmobile MaterialFunctions is zero (944 slots, 0 non-zero in this read), so no operator, input or output link is in the package; G3-04b recorded the same dead end

unknowns.what: the authored default of the body base colour
unknowns.why: MIC 767 overrides `Material0_BaseColour` to [0.025787, 0.025787, 0.03, 1], and the material's own expressions for it (716 in `Batmobile_Worn`, 720 in `Batmobile_Worn_NoRain`, 683 in `Batmobile_V3_Body_NoRain_MAT`) carry no `DefaultValue` tag, so only the override value exists in bytes

unknowns.what: which parameter feeds which material socket (base, dirt, roughness, anisotropy, ...)
unknowns.why: the sockets live in the stripped expression graph; this card decodes parameter identity and values only

unknowns.what: whether the MIC value is what the shader receives
unknowns.why: no runtime oracle exists in the project; this is a file read, not a game measurement

unknowns.what: the pixel/texture contents behind the texture parameters
unknowns.why: only the texture object reference is decoded here (e.g. 5431); the texture payload is an asset, read by another extractor

unknowns.what: lighting, reflection probe and tonemap terms
unknowns.why: shader code, not serialised in the material package (COLOUR.md §5-6)
